examples.description: Change a line's quantity, made against the line as last read
Give a line 2.25 hours and a 5% discount

failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_list or invoice_item_list to find the id (cross-tenant ids are indistinguishable from missing).
failure_modes.when: invoice_id (or the item id) does not name a row in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Retire the payment first (invoice_payment_delete, approval required) or issue a new invoice for additional work.
failure_modes.when: the parent invoice (or a re-parent target) is paid, so its total is ledger-locked

failure_modes.recovery: Issue a new invoice (invoice_create) for the work; a cancelled invoice keeps its lines as issued.
failure_modes.when: the parent invoice (or a re-parent target) is cancelled, which is terminal

failure_modes.recovery: Send the price in integer CENTS, 0 or more ($15.00 → 1500). For a discount, send discount_bps (10% → 1000); for a larger amount, split it across lines or invoices.
failure_modes.when: unit_price_cents is negative or not whole CENTS, quantity is outside 0.001..1,000,000 or has more than 3 decimals, discount_bps is outside 0..10000, or quantity × unit_price_cents is above 10,000,000,000

failure_modes.recovery: Send whole-number lines without unit or discount_bps for now; the owner runs `pnpm db:seed` to enable them.
failure_modes.when: the line has a fractional quantity, a unit or a discount and the platform catalog does not list those line fields yet

failure_modes.recovery: Send a tax_code the error lists (the codes that apply on the document's issue date), or leave tax_code out on a document without a scheme.
failure_modes.when: tax_code is on a line of a document without a tax_scheme, is not a code of the document's scheme or does not apply on its issue date, or is missing on a new line of a my_sst document

failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_read to see the current status and lines, then retry against them; nothing was written.
failure_modes.when: the invoice became paid or cancelled, or another edit changed this line, while this write ran, or expected_updated_at no longer matches the line

failure_modes.recovery: Resend with expected_updated_at set to the line's updated_at from your read (the refusal names the current value; invoice_item_read or quote_item_read shows the line).
failure_modes.when: expected_updated_at is missing: every line edit or removal carries the updated_at of the line it was made against

preconditions: Lines of a PAID invoice are ledger-locked — the stored 'paid' derives from the ledger (payments plus credits ≥ total), so item writes on a paid invoice refuse.
Lines of a CANCELLED invoice are locked too: cancelled is terminal, so a correction is a new invoice.
Every line satisfies quantity × unit_price_cents ≤ 10,000,000,000 with unit_price_cents ≥ 0; a line's amount is quantity × unit_price_cents less discount_bps, rounded to the cent.

description: Edits a line item's description, quantity, unit, price or discount, or re-parents it to another invoice. expected_updated_at is required: the line's updated_at from your read; without it nothing is written and the refusal names the current value; a line changed since then answers CONFLICT. Bounds: unit_price_cents is integer CENTS, 0 or more; quantity 0.001 to 1,000,000 (3 decimals); discount_bps 0 to 10000; quantity × unit_price_cents at most 10,000,000,000. unit "" clears the unit. Refuses when the current or target invoice is paid or cancelled. tax_code is the line's code under the document's tax_scheme, refused on a document without a scheme. NEXT: invoice_read to see the updated total.

discount_bps.description: Optional line discount in basis points: 10% → 1000, none → 0. A discount is never a lower or negative price.

expected_updated_at.description: Required: the line's updated_at from your last read (invoice_item_read, invoice_item_list or the create answer). Left out, the call is refused and names the current value; a line changed since then returns CONFLICT with the current value and stays as it is.

quantity.description: How many, up to 3 decimals (1.5 hours → 1.5). A new line defaults to 1.

name: invoice_item_update
